workspace: Uncommitted implementation; base commit is not a release/build identifier.

methodology.capture: Persistent Windows Graphics Capture of a separate 1920x1080 window displaying a real recorded game frame.
methodology.engine_configuration: Japanese; full scale; furigana threshold 0; same locally installed ScreenAI / OneOCR models and DLLs.
methodology.warmup: One cold scan excluded. Aggregate warm CPU/wall interval includes the sleep following warmup and 20 scan/sleep cycles.
methodology.cpu: Process user+kernel CPU seconds / elapsed seconds; total_machine_percent additionally divides by 16 logical CPUs.
methodology.percentile: Median is the arithmetic mean of the two middle samples; p95 uses nearest rank.
methodology.quality: Normalized Japanese lines match between Python/Rust for each engine and crop. Whitespace, punctuation, paragraph markers and English-only UI lines are excluded from this comparison.
methodology.worker_scope: Rust desktop parent process only; does not include Node service, Python backend, OBS, GPU or fixture processes.
methodology.limitations: One machine, one Japanese game frame, normal desktop load. Worker additionally checks changing pixels, pause, manual scan, preview, and stop. Not a long continuous gameplay, mixed-DPI, or cross-platform benchmark.
